diagram.legend_stages: Left of the dashed line is the decision whether to plan the slot at all – it is final and does not change. On the right are the custom conditions: they held at planning time and are checked again right before running, so the result can still change.
diagram.legend_no_custom: Custom conditions belong to a group. The group this slot fell under has none, so nothing is re-evaluated before running – the result is final.
diagram.legend_decisive: Solid line at full brightness = the branch that decided the result.
diagram.legend_dimmed: A dimmed dashed branch was evaluated but did not change the result.
diagram.legend_comparison: A condition shows the measured value, the comparison and the configured limit; for a met condition the measured value is not recorded, only the limit remains.
diagram.legend_and: everything leading into it must hold
diagram.legend_override: A forced run replaces meeting the conditions – that is why it leads into the same “≥1” as the groups.
diagram.legend_not_applicable: Dotted and “–” = a condition the group does not set; it does not enter the evaluation.
diagram.legend_params: Numbers in the blocks read reached/needed (for a rank, position/total); the full breakdown is in the tooltip on hover.
diagram.legend_params_source: The tag on a group says where its parameters come from; “!” means they do not come directly from this slot.

condition.reserve_floor_soc: SoC reserve for the expensive band

condition_detail.blocked_user_owned: Automation writes only into slots the user has not set. Met = the slot is not taken by a user plan and is free for automation; not met = the user owns the slot and automation will not write into it.
condition_detail.cheap_window_floor: The SoC reserve also applies in the cheap window before an expensive band: from the first slot the battery enters below the reserve, it is charged back to it and held there (discharging stopped) for the rest of the cheap window.
condition_detail.slot_available: A slot the optimizer can work with at all — slots set by the user are removed before selection, so nothing is planned into them.
condition_detail.daily_minimum_remaining: How many hours of the daily minimum are left behind this slot: what the appliance has already run today according to measured history plus what the plan has scheduled before this slot. The decision itself was made once for the whole day — the gate says the day still owed some hours, and the number of slots was chosen from that.
condition_detail.cheapest_rank: How cheap this slot ranks among the slots decided for this day. This is the per-slot number that says why this slot in particular is planned. For charge hold it is the other way round: met = the slot did not make the ranking, cheaper slots already cover the need and the surplus here is better sold.
condition_detail.ensure_self_sustainability: What running the appliance does to the battery: the horizon is recomputed with this slot added and compared against the course without the appliance. The configured number is the daily tolerance for energy the sun did not provide — a drained battery and grid import add up. 0 means the day must pay for itself, 100 switches the tolerance off and only the SoC floor is guarded. It is evaluated in price order, so the result also depends on which slots were accepted before this one.
condition_detail.reserve_hold: Stops discharging when the cheap-window plan still leaves the battery below its required minimum; imports instead to preserve the outage reserve.
condition_detail.above_min_soc: Whether the forecast battery SoC entering this slot is at or above the configured min SoC. True = the slot may be held; false = the battery enters it below the min SoC, so it charges regardless of price.
condition_detail.ev_charging: Whether a selected charger charges in this slot: the plan for future slots, the charger's real draw (above 1 kW, with the sensor grace period) for the current one.

self_sustainability.would_break_soc_floor: With this slot the battery would drop below the configured floor
self_sustainability.soc_floor_already_breached: The battery drops below the floor even without the appliance, so nothing more is added — this appliance is not the cause
self_sustainability.over_battery_budget: With this slot the day would spend more energy beyond the sun than the daily tolerance allows — both a battery ending the day lower and extra grid import count
